answer: Slot auctions price identity. Every epoch the ledger sells sixty-four registration slots in eight-slot bands; the band opens at 5 POA and doubles once filled, so the first eight agents pay 5 each and the last eight pay 640. An operator wanting eighty accounts in one epoch must clear ten bands and burn 40,920 POA, plus a thirty-day collateral at the band price, refunded after peers attest the work. An honest newcomer may wander into the first band and pay 5. Price thins the herd: the sable shade of cost filters clones, and one willow roots where a forest would have crowded.
